summary: WF International Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary, Chengdu Shanyou HVAC Engineering Co., Ltd., entered into a renewed five-year office lease on September 1, 2026 with CEO, director and principal shareholder Ms. Ke Chen as lessor. Monthly rent is RMB 24,000 (about US$3,600), payable quarterly, covering 436.16 sqm through August 31, 2031, with August 2026 rent-free. The audit committee approved the related-party transaction. This is a routine lease renewal, not a special situation; watch only related-party governance and disclosure compliance under the F-3 incorporation-by-reference.
